text:
Anna (CS): quick ping — Stratus preview cohort (wave B) needs enrollment confirmation by EOD Fri. they reported SSO delays and want a short enablement session.
Ravi (Enablement): noted. can we squeeze a 30m session Tues morning? timezone PST.
Lee (SolutionsEng): I can do Tue 9am PT but need the SSO artifact checklist from them beforehand. asked for screenshots earlier, they haven't sent.
Anna (CS): they said they'd upload tonight. i'll DM their PM to nudge. who owns the enrollment link? onboard-bot: Enrollment link generated: https://redwood.example/s/stratus-waveb - expires 2024-06-18 23:59 UTC.
Ravi (Enablement): thanks bot. can we attach a quick agenda: 1) SSO walk, 2) onboarding flows, 3) initial eval prompts? keep under 30m.
Lee (SolutionsEng): yep. i'll prepare a short slide with redirect rules + sample env vars. also include rollback steps in case session breaks.
Anna (CS): heads up — Stratus flagged renewal as "at risk" due to procurement timeline. if onboarding slips more than 2 weeks, legal may push renewal. we should triage. :warning:
Ravi (Enablement): propose a 'fast lane' setup: temporary API key with scoped access, limited seats, to let product team start testing while SSO is gated. legal ok with temporary keys?
Lee (SolutionsEng): temporary scoped keys are fine; we should log access and auto-revoke after 21 days. on our side: quick policy + IAM ticket.
Anna (CS): ok let's offer that as option in the enablement session. i'll frame it as "pilot access" to mitigate churn.
Ravi (Enablement): suggest we capture a 1-question pulse at the end of the session: "can you run your 3 core flows? yes/no" so we get an immediate signal.
Anna (CS): agreed. i'll add to the session deck and to the calendar invite.
onboard-bot: Calendar invite created: Tue 2024-06-11 16:00 UTC — "Stratus wave B: quick enablement (30m)" — attendees: Anna (CS), Lee (SolutionsEng), Ravi (Enablement), Stratus PM.
Lee (SolutionsEng): small ask — can someone surface any previous Stratus feedback? last time they hit long-tail latency on embeddings. might need a model suggestion for low-latency eval.
Anna (CS): i pulled their last feedback thread: they prioritized latency and cost. i'll paste summary in thread after DM.
Ravi (Enablement): during the session i'll demo a lightweight prompt set and show how to pin a smaller model variant for staging. that should reduce cost & latency.
Anna (CS): next steps: 1) Ravi prepare agenda + pulse question (due Mon EOD). 2) Lee prepare SSO + rollback notes + model recommendation (Mon EOD). 3) Anna confirm screenshots and send enrollment link (tonight). 4) i'll draft renewal mitigation note for AM.
Lee (SolutionsEng): ack.
Ravi (Enablement): ack.
Anna (CS): thanks all. ping me if Stratus uploads the SSO screenshots so i can forward. :thumbsup:
onboard-bot: Reminder scheduled: 24h before session — send join link and pulse question.
